source_title: Cockroach Janta Party backs INDIA bloc’s November 1 rally - The Hindu
source_excerpt: New Delhi The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), on Wednesday (October 28, 2026), extended its support to the INDIA bloc’s November 1 rally against the irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, reiterating its demand for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation. https://www.thehindu.com/topic/cockroach-janta-party/ In a statement shared on social media, the CJP said the SIR had raised serious concerns over the possible exclusion of eligible voters, arguing that the Election Commission of India’s responsibility was to safeguard every citizen’s right to vote. Ambedkar, the CJP said democracy depended on ensuring equal political representation and protecting every eligible citizen’s voting rights. “The fundamental principle of democracy is that people get to choose their government, not that the government gets to choose its voters,” the party said, alleging that the SIR exercise had undermined public confidence in the electoral process.
